about: An AWK interpreter written in Go, with built-in support for CSV files.

prs.title: CSV header mode reads Excel CSV files again
prs.broken: With the CSV header option, a small file saved from Excel as CSV UTF-8 gave no rows at all, because of a hidden mark at its start.
prs.changed: The CSV reader now keeps going after skipping that mark and the header, so the rows after them are read.
prs.matters: Scripts that process spreadsheet exports get their data instead of an empty result.
